lines: Mujh se pehli si mohabbat, mere mehboob, na maang.
couplets.en: My love, do not ask me to love you as I once did.

lines: Mujh se pehli si mohabbat, mere mehboob, na maang.

lines: Tera gham hai to gham-e-dahr ka jhagda kya hai?
Teri surat se hai aalam mein bahaaron ko sabaat.
couplets.en: The world's sorrows seemed small beside yours, and your face kept spring alive.

lines: Teri aankhon ke siwa duniya mein rakha kya hai?
couplets.en: Beyond your eyes, what does the world hold?

lines: Tu jo mil jaaye to taqdeer nigoon ho jaaye.
Yun na tha, maine faqat chaha tha yun ho jaaye.
couplets.en: I only wished that fate would bow if I found you.

lines: Mujh se pehli si mohabbat, mere mehboob, na maang.
couplets.en: My love, do not ask me to love you as I once did.

lines: Anginat sadiyon ke taareek baheemana tilism.
Anginat sadiyon ke taareek baheemana tilism.
couplets.en: The dark, brutal spells of countless centuries endure.

lines: Resham o atlas o kamkhwab mein bunwaaye hue.
couplets.en: Those spells are woven into silk, satin and brocade.

lines: Ja-ba-ja bikte hue kucha-o-bazaar mein jism.
Khaak mein lithde hue, khoon mein nahlaaye hue.
couplets.en: Bodies caked in dust and bathed in blood are sold in streets and markets everywhere.

lines: Laut jaati hai udhar ko bhi nazar, kya kije?
couplets.en: My gaze keeps returning there too, what can I do?

lines: Ab bhi dilkash hai tera husn, magar kya kije?
couplets.en: Your beauty still draws me, but what can I do?

lines: Ab bhi dilkash hai tera husn, magar kya kije?
couplets.en: Your beauty still draws me, but what can I do?

lines: Aur bhi dukh hain zamaane mein mohabbat ke siwa.
Raahatein aur bhi hain vasl ki raahat ke siwa.
couplets.en: The world holds sorrows besides love, and comforts besides being together.
